title: Sindhu Wins Japan Open With Scorching Win Over Yamaguchi
indian_angle: PV Sindhu ended her title drought by winning the Japan Open, defeating local favorite Akane Yamaguchi in a dominant performance, signaling a strong return to form for India's Olympic medalist.
summary: PV Sindhu clinched the Japan Open title with a commanding victory over home favorite Akane Yamaguchi, marking a significant end to her recent title drought and a powerful comeback.

title: Sindhu: 'People Asked if My Career Was Done, But I Kept Believing'

summary: Following her Japan Open triumph, PV Sindhu revealed the immense pressure and doubts she faced about her career, emphasizing her unwavering belief that led to her successful comeback.

title: Player Eligibility for Selection – World Junior Championships 2026

summary: The Badminton Association of India has released a circular detailing the eligibility requirements for players aspiring to represent India at the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: 3x15 Scoring System to be Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The new 3x15 scoring system will be implemented across all domestic junior ranking tournaments and national championships, marking a significant change for Indian youth badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
